name: usm
description: Structured source of truth for human + AI software development. Schema-validated specs, 18 MCP tools, auto-generated docs. Works with any MCP-compatible editor.
long_description: USM (Universal System Map) is a spec-first development tool that gives AI agents structured context about your system. Write specs in YAML validated by a JSON Schema, and USM generates markdown docs, Mermaid diagrams, OpenAPI specs, TOGAF deliverables, and Vitest test scaffolds. 18 MCP tools let agents read, search, draft, write, and update specs — using 10-20x fewer tokens than bloated Markdown vaults.

tools.name: usm_list
tools.description: List all .usm files with id, type, version, and summary

tools.name: usm_search
tools.description: Search all .usm files for a query string

tools.name: usm_query
tools.description: Query .usm files with a predicate expression

tools.name: usm_references
